transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... well, they made me the acting workflow lead at the warehouse recently. Ever since then, I just... I walk in already tense. I've been snapping at people over little SAP errors, which isn't really like me. And I'm missing cycle-count deadlines that I never used to miss. By the time I get home, I'm just too drained to play basketball or even work on my sketches. It's just... a lot right now.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about things at work or outside of work?

I don't know if I'd call it... anxious. I just think about the warehouse a lot. The new role and making sure things get done. Outside of work, not really. Like I said, I'm mostly just too tired to worry about much else.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Not really. I just... I don't feel like doing much. I wouldn't say I'm sad, just... drained, I guess.
Do you feel anxious when you're at the warehouse and something isn't going as planned?
I mean... I wouldn't say anxious. Like I said, I just get tense. If something's messed up, it's just... frustrating. I just want to get it fixed, that's all.
Have you been feeling sad most of the day, nearly every day?
No, not really. Just... tired, mostly. Like I told you.
Are you enjoying things you used to like, such as playing basketball or working on your sketches, less than you used to?

Yeah, I guess. I haven't been playing basketball lately. Or sketching. Just... haven't had the energy. Work's been taking over everything. It's even... well, my supervisor brought up some missed cycle-count deadlines recently during a check-in. So, yeah. Just haven't been doing much else.
Are you still able to find pleasure in the things you do?
I don't know. I guess. I just... haven't really thought about it.
Do you feel like you're not enjoying the things you used to enjoy as much as you used to?
I mean... I think I just answered that. I haven't really been doing them. So... I don't know if I enjoy them less or not. I just haven't tried.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that you still find pleasure in?
I'm not sure. Like I said, work's just... it's all I'm really focused on right now. I haven't really been doing much else to know if I'd enjoy it or not.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?

Nervous? ...I don't know about nervous. Tense, maybe. Yeah. Ever since they made me the acting workflow lead, I just... I walk into the warehouse and I'm already tense. 

I'll end up snapping over little SAP errors, which isn't like me. And I'm missing cycle-count deadlines that I never used to miss. By the time my shift is over... I just go home. I'm too drained to play basketball or even work on my sketches. So... yeah. Just tense, mostly.
Do you feel anxious when you are not at work?
Not really. I mean... I'm just tired when I get home. I don't really think about it. I just try to tune out.
Do you find yourself irritable most of the time, even when you're not thinking about work?
No, not really. Like I said, I'm mostly just tired. I don't really get mad or anything when I'm at home. I just... I don't have the energy for it.
Do you ever feel anxious when you're not thinking about work or the warehouse?
I don't think so. I mean... no, not really. It's just the warehouse. When I'm not there, I'm just out of it.
Do you often find yourself getting irritated or frustrated with the people you're with when you're not at work?
No. I... mostly just keep to myself anyway. Like I said, I'm too tired to get worked up about anything.
Are you having trouble sleeping because of your tension or fatigue?
No. I sleep fine. I mean... I'm so tired by the time I get home, I just kind of pass out.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with friends or family since you started feeling this way?

I don't really see anyone right now. I... I stopped showing up for basketball with the guys. I don't even do my usual sketching anymore. It just feels like work is taking over my whole life. 

Which doesn't even make sense, because I'm messing up there, too. My supervisor had to pull me into a performance check-in the other day because I missed some cycle-count deadlines. So... yeah. I just haven't been around anyone much.
Have you been having any physical symptoms like headaches or stomach problems since you started feeling tense and drained?
No, not really. I mean... maybe a headache sometimes, but nothing major. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Have you been experiencing these feelings of tension and fatigue for more than six months?
No... not six months. It's been about four months, I guess. Just... since they merged the inventory teams at work. They put me in this acting workflow lead role, so... yeah. That's when it started.
Have you been having persistent and excessive worry about the warehouse or your role as acting workflow lead?
No, not really. I mean... I don't sit around worrying about it all day. It's just... stressful when I have to be there. But I wouldn't say I'm excessively worrying.
Has there been a significant change or stressor in your life, other than the new role at work, that coincided with when you started feeling tense and drained?
No. Just the work thing. Nothing else really changed.
